chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who slandered a woman cursed by her husband, he said: Upon him is the Penalty (Hadd).
ai.seo_question: What is the legal penalty for a man who performs li'an with his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies that the specific Hadd penalty for Qadhf (slander) applies to the husband after the conclusion of the Li'an procedure, distinguishing the final verdict from the preliminary oaths. It highlights the jurisprudential nuance in Shia fiqh regarding whether the accusation constitutes formal slander once the mutual cursing process is complete, affirming the legal accountability of the accuser.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding a man who slandered a woman cursed by her husband. Heasws said: ‘Upon him is the Penalty (Hadd)’.
